invariants.rationale: Method dereferences writeMetadata, so it must not be null.
Code calls stream() on writeMetadata.getWriteStatuses(), requiring it to be non-null.
Method accesses methods on each WriteStatus; none may be null.
Method calls getStat() on each WriteStatus; each must return non-null.
writeMetadata is parameterized as List<WriteStatus>, so getWriteStatuses() returns a List.
